The '''liberation of Thaere''' was a military campaign in the [[Thaereian system]] that the [[Cularin Militia|Cularin Armed Forces]]&mdash;a branch of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]&mdash;participated in during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The unit [[Beta Company (Cularin Militia)|Beta Company]] fought during the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The liberation of Thaere was originally scheduled to appear in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] interactive adventure [[Situation Room (adventure)|''Situation Room'']].<ref name="Decision: Cularin">{{LivingForce|Decision: Cularin}}</ref> However, the adventure was later cut.
